claims: Hulu has officially renewed Paradise for a third season ahead of its Season 2 finale on March 30, 2026.
Creator Dan Fogelman planned a three-season arc from the beginning.
Hulu officially renewed Paradise in March 2026.
The writers' room for Paradise is already active.
Work on the writers' room for Paradise started well ahead of the renewal announcement.
Paradise Season 3's story will continue to follow Xavier Collins after the high-stakes developments of Season 2.
Sterling K. Brown plays Xavier Collins.
Paradise Season 2 has over 30 million hours of viewership shortly after its launch
Paradise's Season 2 finale is on March 30, 2026.
